verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS terminal that ships its own local command set, so bundling git and supporting commit amend or undo is a fair question for this kind of product. However, none of the evidence documents git at all. The listed local commands are file and network utilities (cat, grep, ls, curl, scp, sftp, and similar). Running git on a remote host over SSH, or through a connected VS Code or Codespaces session, would be a user-side or external workaround, not Blink's own capability, so it earns no credit.
